title: KCSAN: data-race in ip_finish_output2 / ip_tunnel_xmit
two_threads_summary: KCSAN-reported two-context race. KCSAN: data-race in ip_finish_output2 / ip_tunnel_xmit
audit_notes: Subject: 'net: tunnels: annotate lockless accesses to dev->needed_headroom'. Pre-classifier PROBABLY_GOOD (real synchronization primitives on + lines).
fix_commit_message:
4b397c06cb987935b1b097336532aa6b4210e091
net: tunnels: annotate lockless accesses to dev->needed_headroom

IP tunnels can apparently update dev->needed_headroom
in their xmit path.

This patch takes care of three tunnels xmit, and also the
core LL_RESERVED_SPACE() and LL_RESERVED_SPACE_EXTRA()
helpers.

More changes might be needed for completeness.
